verdict.rationale: Pilot's evidence only glancingly touches this story. It markets real-time expense tracking that finds wasted spend [pilot-docs-13] and on-demand AI answers about past transactions [pilot-docs-7], while the monthly close is handled by human bookkeepers through the portal [pilot-docs-18]. Missing for 10: an agent that proactively monitors the ledger, automated anomaly flagging, duplicate-transaction detection, pre-close alerting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
